info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Petadoption Pets Schedule Visit-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates scheduling visits for pet adoptions, enabling prospective pet owners to arrange meet-and-greet sessions with animals available for adoption. Users can specify their preferred date and time for the visit, ensuring a tailored experience when interacting with the pets. This endpoint is particularly beneficial for animal shelters and adoption agencies looking to streamline the process for potential adopters. Typical consumers include pet adoption organizations and individuals interested in providing a forever home to pets in need.

post.summary: Schedule a visit for a pet.
